result: Confirmed genuine original vector artwork in two original publication PDFs.

sources.title: Take Care: A handbook for families caring for older adults
sources.publication_date_evidence: Page 2 states revised in 2000; back cover form code HED2050 00/08.

sources.title: Directional Plan: Working Together for Better Health 2000–2003
sources.note: Open heart/negative-space monochrome variant. Original cover background pale cream is preserved in source crop only; logo SVG/PDF have no added background.

method: Isolate original PDF content-stream path operators belonging to logo, preserving original coordinates, Bézier control points, fills, strokes, overprint state and colour resources; copy source page resources, remove unused Font resources, set crop to logo; export isolated PDF through PyMuPDF SVG writer. No tracing, reconstruction, smoothing, recolouring or font substitution. All lettering was already vector outlines in source.
colour_note: Original named Pantone colours and PDF colour-space definitions remain in colour PDFs. SVG colours are RGB conversions of those definitions and are not a replacement print colour standard. White dry-brush knockout shapes in two-colour source have been preserved as white shapes, not converted to transparency.

variant_comparison: The colour source is not merely a recolouring of the monochrome source: the two-spot Take Care artwork includes explicit fine strokes around name letters and apple elements, and white knockout shapes in the colour emblem. The Directional Plan one-colour artwork uses filled compound paths, with an open negative-space heart. Each extraction preserves its publication-specific original geometry and colour treatment.
